text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, so many! I'm sure this arcade 
cabinet is happy that everyone enjoyed 
playing it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, right. Since you managed to win so 
many prizes for me, I ought to give you a 
special award of my own."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I just said that in the 
heat of the moment without really thinking 
about what I meant..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What would be suitable...? For variety 
show segments, things like TVs, audio 
equipment, cars, or yachts—
choice_data_list:
W-winning your race is what would make me 
happiest...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
! Understood! I will definitely bring us 
victory!
